verdict.rationale: Foreloop's evidence covers feedback collection (widget submissions), routing to projects, and agent-driven intention/task creation from individual reports — but nothing about aggregating feedback into themes, running analytics, or connecting to revenue data. No mention of revenue impact analysis or thematic insight querying via an AI assistant appears anywhere in the pack. [2026-09-30 judge-migration owner-product bias audit: reverted opus-5-5 partial q3 -> the committed sonnet-5 baseline none q0. The credit rests on 'an AI assistant could in principle be pointed at feedback' — the rationale's own words — with theme analysis unevidenced and revenue impact 'never mentioned'. In-principle inference is not evidence ABOUT the story. Ultrametric-affiliation governance, README §9.]
